curves.why: guess: no personalisation under 3 completions (O5, AMD-008 F4); half at 9; full at 30
guess: 1 miss in 5 is noise, 2-3 in 5 is a pattern; capped at .9; weighted above recall rate as fresher evidence
guess: failing half of first revisits means forgetting, not noise; W-1497 may move the knee
guess: success is the main readiness evidence for the next concept, so it carries .6
guess: an open frontier is an opportunity, not a need on its own; capped at .8
guess: <5 of 10 in one domain is broad, >=7 of 10 is a bubble forming; single term so w=1
guess: stretch needs >=4 of 5 right, stricter than build, because early stretch confuses (O8)
guess: inverse: low recent level leaves room to stretch, at stretch level there is none; equal weight to success

noveltyGate.why: inactive: killed on phase A readout 1 (0 of 6 wins vs gam-no-surprise-novelty at novelty benefit 0 and +.05; W-1536, W-1542)

antiBubbleFloor.counts: completed new cards only, rebuilt from history (permitted inputs, no served log is stored): a card counts as moved if it was not the first eligible card of the default order when it was completed. Learner-chosen cards (map, search) and pre-personalisation history count as moved, so a first session usually starts on the default card. Cards left before the reveal and due revisits do not count. Past items are judged against today's default order and filter, so a catalog change can shift the count.
antiBubbleFloor.knownGap: skipped moved cards do not count (sim: max 4 moved served in a row vs 2 completed)

objective.primary: mean simulated first spaced-revisit recall over ALL lessons completed (not only moved ones)
guardrails: share of completed new cards in the learner's top domain does not rise vs default-order (breadth)
distinct concepts completed does not fall vs default-order (breadth within a domain)
share of cards shown before their prerequisites does not rise
objective.passCriterion: W-1496 (personalization org, pending role approval), written before the first run

conditions: F2 (historySize never shown as a number or label)
P1 recall-only fallback stays buildable and tested
P2 null is absent, never wrong
P3 reason copy names an act, never a trait or comparison
P4 read to order, never counted or stored
F1 30-day window over results; never days-since-last or per-day counts
SS4 deleted/exported with the account; anonymous local
SS5 never visible to others or in aggregates
